question.body:
The functions $f$ and $g$ are given by $f(x)= integral_(0)^(3 x) sqrt(4 + t^(2)) d t$ and $g(x)= f(sin x)$.

(a) Find $f'(x)$ and $g'(x)$.

(b) Write an equation for the line tangent to the graph of $y = g(x)$ at $x = pi$.

(c) Write, but do not evaluate, an integral expression that represents the maximum value of $g$ on the interval $0 <= x <= pi$. Justify your answer.
